parsed_json.explanation: Time complexity is O(n * k log k) where n is the array length and k is the average number of enumerable keys per object. Each object requires enumerating its keys (O(k)), sorting them (O(k log k)), and building a JSON string (O(k)); the JSON string is used as an O(1) average-case hash lookup. Space complexity is O(n * k) to store the distinct JSON signatures in the seen map, proportional to the number of kept objects and their keys. Inputs are never mutated since only reads and a fresh result array are used.
